description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between BLEU score and average lagging (AL) for four different models: Consistency-CE, Inconsistency-CE, Inconsistency-CE-MP, and Consistency-Bi. The x-axis represents the average lagging, ranging from 2 to 8, while the y-axis represents the BLEU score, ranging from 20 to 30. The Consistency-CE model, represented by a light purple line with circle markers, shows a steady increase in BLEU score from approximately 20.2 to 29.5 as the average lagging increases from 2 to 8. The Inconsistency-CE model, represented by a dark purple line with square markers, also shows a steady increase in BLEU score from approximately 22.3 to 29.8 as the average lagging increases from 2 to 8. The Inconsistency-CE-MP model, represented by a blue line with square markers, shows a steady increase in BLEU score from approximately 22.3 to 29.3 as the average lagging increases from 2 to 8. The Consistency-Bi model, represented by a red line with star markers, shows a steady increase in BLEU score from approximately 24.8 to 30.3 as the average lagging increases from 2 to 8. All models show an increase in BLEU score as the average lagging increases, with the Consistency-Bi model achieving the highest BLEU score at each level of average lagging.
